screen.title: Conversation: A registration mix-up
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between a student and an employee at the registrar's office.

audio.text: Hi, I registered for Introduction to Biology last week, but it isn't on my schedule anymore.
Let me look. Ah, the system dropped you because the lab section you picked was already full.
So I can't take the course this term?
You can. There's still a seat in the Thursday lab. If I move you there, the lecture comes back too.

questions.stem: Why does the student go to the office?
options: She wants to change the time of her biology lecture
A course she signed up for has disappeared from her schedule
She was charged twice for the same biology course
Her lab partner asked her to switch to a different lab section with him

why.en: Main problem (paraphrase of "it isn't on my schedule anymore"). A reverses the request: she wants the course back, not a new lecture time. C and D are never mentioned.
why.tr: Ana sorun ("it isn't on my schedule anymore" ifadesinin parafrazı). A isteği tersine çeviriyor: ders saatini değiştirmek değil, dersi geri istiyor. C ve D hiç geçmiyor.
why.es: Problema principal (paráfrasis de "it isn't on my schedule anymore"). A invierte la petición: quiere recuperar el curso, no cambiar la hora. C y D no se mencionan.

questions.stem: What will the man most likely do next?
options: Put the student in a different lab section
Cancel the student's registration for the course
Ask the biology department to open a new lab
Tell the student to register again next term

why.en: Inference: he offers to move her to the Thursday lab and she agrees ("Please do that"). B and D contradict "You can"; C is never suggested.
why.tr: Çıkarım: onu Perşembe laboratuvarına almayı öneriyor ve öğrenci kabul ediyor ("Please do that"). B ve D "You can" ifadesiyle çelişiyor; C hiç önerilmiyor.
why.es: Inferencia: le ofrece pasarla al laboratorio del jueves y ella acepta ("Please do that"). B y D contradicen "You can"; C no se propone.
